title: File:Schlachthof Crimmitschau.jpg
desc:
The photo shows the old municipal slaughterhouse in the small town of Crimmitschau, Saxony.
Founded in 1899, it served as a municipal slaughterhouse and was in operation until 1993. An investor had it converted into an extraordinary residential complex. The left section still houses a butcher's shop
